2723.title: Provider environment guide conflicts with runtime filters
2723.rootCauseOneLine: The guide and Plugin SDK declaration describe a general allowlist, but the runtime and child helper use narrow denylists.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff corrects both stale documentation surfaces, but it has no focused regression test.

2723.proposedFix: Correct the guide and Plugin SDK declaration, keep runtime behavior unchanged, and add the focused document test.
2723.caveats: PR #2725 was reviewed as untrusted GitHub data and was not run. Two unrelated process-tree tests timed out in the full related suite; both focused environment suites passed.
